title: Learning Tactile-Aware Hand Representations from Human Hand-Object Interaction Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.27995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tactile representation learning for dexterous manipulation often requires substantial robot-side data collection, limiting its scalability across different hands and sensors. We explore whether large-scale human hand-object interaction (HOI) data can provide a useful prior for robotic tactile learning. To this end, we propose HuTact, a framework that pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from human HOI data without requiring real tactile signals during pretraining. HuTact transfers the interaction structure learned from human hand motions to robotic tactile observations and can be further adapted with a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data. We evaluate HuTact on tactile perception and manipulation tasks, including grasp prediction, slip detection, object classification, and tactile-conditioned policy learning. translated_title: 从人手-物体交互数据中学习触觉感知的手部表征
translated_abstract: 面向灵巧操作的触觉表征学习通常需要大量的机器人端数据采集，这限制了其在不同机械手和传感器之间的可扩展性。我们探索大规模的人类手-物体交互（HOI）数据能否为机器人触觉学习提供有用的先验。为此，我们提出了HuTact，一个从人类HOI数据中预训练触觉感知手部表征的框架，且在预训练过程中无需真实的触觉信号。HuTact将从人类手部动作中学到的交互结构迁移到机器人触觉观测中，并能通过少量无标注的机器人交互数据进一步适配。我们在触觉感知与操作任务上评估了HuTact，包括抓取预测、滑移检测、物体分类以及触觉条件策略学习。在这些任务上，人类HOI预训练提升了数据效率，并提供了强大的初始化。
tldr: 提出HuTact框架，从大规模人类手-物体交互数据中预训练触觉感知的手部表征，无需真实触觉信号即可通过少量机器人数据适配，显著提升机器人触觉学习的数据效率与跨手部、跨传感器的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: HuTact pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from large-scale human hand-object interaction data without requiring real tactile signals, enabling adaptation with limited robot data and improving data efficiency and scalability for robotic tactile learning.
